architecture_conclusion: Justified cohesive ownership split: durable row/crypto/migration/database, guarded state transitions, two independent delivery lanes, and lock-held closeout/logout have different lifetimes. Most individual functions are already bounded (largest110 source lines); a generic rewrite or arbitrary splitting of small functions is not justified. Preserve whole functions and move ownership first.

constraints.preserve: DB name passdetection-tour-ops/version5 and all existing store/index/key paths. Stored pending/rejected storageVersion5, AES-GCM identity, exact AAD tuples including legacy-group fallback, SHA-256 reference/id shapes, copy/decrypt/verify-before-replace and invalid/unattributable legacy rows retained. QR and optional recovery labels encrypted; discard payload remains count/continuity-only. Migration promise singleton and failed-run reset stay per module instance; no schema bump or data deletion.

Same queue owner index, expectedOwnerUserId transport fences and actor checks before/after relevant awaits. Closeout validates userId+sessionVersion and holds owner queue lock through publish. Browser Web Lock names/modes unchanged: migration, per-owner queue, per-owner drain; publisher lock remains outside queue lock. No nested reacquisition/deadlock introduced. Existing fallbackOwnerLanes map serializes one JS process only, not cross-tab; this limitation is not newly solved or claimed solved.

One activeSync singleton, same-owner promise dedup, other-owner await/recurse, offline behavior; stable queuedAt traversal, exact compatibility filter and max50 same-session grouping, original event IDs/scannedAt/device/runtime/QR, generated batch ID, exact envelope and item identity checks. Claim before send, owner guards after decryption/response, stop after ambiguous/recoverable failure, release/retain on storage failure, success only authoritative counted/duplicate, permanent terminal quarantine. Progress emission suppressed after owner change. Retry attempt/jitter/Retry-After caps and next-attempt scheduler unchanged.

Atomic pending/rejected deletion plus privacy-safe tombstone creation, exactly five reason strings, event UUID/runtime/capture/reference continuity, first50 due pending audit rows, ownership checks before/after network, accepted/already-recorded synchronized versus rejected dispositions, retry on failures, synchronized-only30-day purge. No QR/passenger labels in audit HTTP payload. Pending/rejected/audit stores remain separate durable responsibilities.

Voluntary logout default block with explicit staged discard; auth loss/account change deliberately preserve owner-scoped queues. Fail-closed storage inspection, existing generic publish<T>/onAllowed public callback signatures, count-only checkpoint collection, oldest age cap and publisher coalescing lanes. Explicit discard currently allows onAllowed after purge; unscoped legacy rows are skipped, so any correction requires its own control rather than silent architectural behavior change.

All current public exports/signatures/return and error semantics, direct re-export of single AttendanceQueueCapacityError constructor and constant5000; no facade wrapper/proxy or second state singleton. Existing mocked/real imports keep calling actual implementation. Lexical contracts currently read one big file; any authorized move must bind real imported owners and retain every assertion body, plus exact function/statement proofs. Do not claim source regex tests establish real browser/crypto/transaction behavior.

findings.status: source-supported candidate; no runtime reproduction during read-only phase
findings.observation: Pending claim persists storageVersion5 deliveryState=sending before network. Protected-v5 normalization returns existing row without applying the two-minute legacy-only stale-claim conversion; claims reject any sending row and wakeup excludes sending. Discard sends similarly persist sending, while selection accepts only pending and no startup reset was found in traced owners. Normal document termination after durable claim may strand work/audit evidence across restart.
findings.proof_gap: Existing owner timing tests begin pending and exercise caught errors/owner changes, not a fresh module/document opening a previously committed sending row. Must add a normal restart control through actual public APIs, stale/fresh ownership/lock controls and idempotency evidence before selecting a fix; never claim a reproduced vulnerability from this static read.
